create_davis_dataset: create a DavisDataset instance to load video frames, optical flow, and foreground masks for dynamic NeRF training
calculate_average_poses: calculate the average camera pose from a set of (N, 3, 4) poses using average_poses
center_poses_for_ndc: center camera poses around the average pose for NDC space using center_poses
generate_spiral_render_path: generate a spiral rendering path from camera poses using get_spiral for novel view synthesis
warp_image_with_flow: warp an image using optical flow with warp_flow to align frames temporally
